COALESCE(
      "wxyc_schema"."rotation"."rotation_bin",
      CASE WHEN "wxyc_schema"."flowsheet"."rotation_id" IS NULL
        AND coalesce("wxyc_schema"."flowsheet"."artist_name", '') <> ''
        AND coalesce("wxyc_schema"."flowsheet"."album_title", '') <> ''
      THEN (
        SELECT t.rotation_bin FROM (
          -- (a) library-linked rotation rows, matched on album_id (album_id_idx).
          --     There is deliberately no "album_id IS NOT NULL" guard here:
          --     SQL equality against NULL is NULL, never true, so a free-form
          --     entry already matches nothing. That guard was inherited from
          --     the OR form, where it was equally redundant. Removing it was
          --     verified equivalent over 1,030 real rows plus a synthetic
          --     NULL-album_id row: 0 disagreements, identical buffers.
          --     (No backticks in this template -- they close the sql tag.)
          SELECT r2.id, r2.rotation_bin
          FROM "wxyc_schema"."rotation" r2
          WHERE r2.album_id = "wxyc_schema"."flowsheet"."album_id"
            AND r2.add_date <= "wxyc_schema"."flowsheet"."add_time"::date
            AND (r2.kill_date IS NULL OR r2.kill_date > "wxyc_schema"."flowsheet"."add_time"::date)
          UNION ALL
          -- (b) library-unlinked rotation rows holding the (artist, album)
          --     snapshot directly (rotation_norm_artist_album_idx)
          SELECT r2.id, r2.rotation_bin
          FROM "wxyc_schema"."rotation" r2
          WHERE lower(trim(coalesce(r2.artist_name, ''))) = lower(trim("wxyc_schema"."flowsheet"."artist_name"))
            AND lower(trim(coalesce(r2.album_title, ''))) = lower(trim("wxyc_schema"."flowsheet"."album_title"))
            AND r2.add_date <= "wxyc_schema"."flowsheet"."add_time"::date
            AND (r2.kill_date IS NULL OR r2.kill_date > "wxyc_schema"."flowsheet"."add_time"::date)
          UNION ALL
          -- (c) library-linked rotation rows whose denorm fields are NULL, so
          --     the names come from the library+artists join
          --     (library_norm_album_title_idx -> album_id_idx -> artists_norm_name_idx)
          SELECT r2.id, r2.rotation_bin
          FROM "wxyc_schema"."rotation" r2
          JOIN "wxyc_schema"."library" l2 ON l2.id = r2.album_id
          JOIN "wxyc_schema"."artists" a2 ON a2.id = l2.artist_id
          WHERE lower(trim(coalesce(a2.artist_name, ''))) = lower(trim("wxyc_schema"."flowsheet"."artist_name"))
            AND lower(trim(coalesce(l2.album_title, ''))) = lower(trim("wxyc_schema"."flowsheet"."album_title"))
            AND r2.add_date <= "wxyc_schema"."flowsheet"."add_time"::date
            AND (r2.kill_date IS NULL OR r2.kill_date > "wxyc_schema"."flowsheet"."add_time"::date)
        ) t
        ORDER BY t.id
        LIMIT 1
      )
      END
    )
